interpretation.dynamic_policy_detail: LRU and Belady replay Top-10 token rows sequentially from the W1 plan; Belady is the optimistic sequential replacement bound. A native invocation whose working set exceeds Q cannot be made runnable by these oracle results.
interpretation.static_frequency: Per-layer W1 development frequency plan evaluated unchanged on W2/W4 holdouts; misses are distinct nonresident experts per native invocation.
interpretation.transfer_accounting: One miss expert equals 9,830,400 BF16 payload bytes; padding, metadata, conversion, publication, and overlap are excluded.
